infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: CYPHR uses Bluetooth to create mesh networks for offline communication during emergencies.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: CYPHR uses Bluetooth to discover and connect to nearby mesh nodes.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: CYPHR uses local networking for peer-to-peer mesh communication.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CYPHR needs access to your location to share coordinates when you broadcast an SOS beacon.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: CYPHR needs location access to broadcast SOS beacons even when the app is backgrounded.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CYPHR needs microphone access to record voice messages for mesh broadcasting.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: Allow CYPHR to connect to nearby mesh nodes using Bluetooth.
